hero.logoAlt: Root Further — Sun* Annual Awards 2025 theme
rootFurther.para1:
Facing the whirlwind of change in the AI era and ever-rising client expectations, Sun* has chosen a strategy of diversifying capability — not merely striving for excellence within our own field, but reaching for something higher: a place where every Sunner is a “problem-solver”, an expert at untangling any issue and finding answers to whatever a project, a client or society puts in front of us.
Inspired by that breadth of capability, by the agility to grow in new directions, and by the will to dig deep and break through in the age of AI, “Root Further” was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards 2025 ceremony.
Beyond its surface meaning, “Root Further” is the journey of reaching ever further, rooting ever deeper, touching the hidden “strata” below so that we may endure, rise, and keep alive the Sun* passion for creating value. Just as roots drive relentlessly into the earth, threading through each layer of “sediment” to draw out what is most nourishing, Sun* people are absorbing what this era and this market's challenges have to offer — renewing ourselves daily, widening our capability, and rooting firmly into the age of AI: a wholly new stratum, complex and unpredictable, yet dense with potential and opportunity.
rootFurther.quote:
“A tree with deep roots fears no storm”
(English proverb)
rootFurther.para2:
In a storm, only the trees with strong enough roots stand firm. An organisation of individuals confident in their many capabilities, ready to create and to take on challenges, at ease with change — that organisation not only holds steady through upheaval but turns every advantage to account and conquers what the times demand. “Root Further” is not simply the name of a new chapter in how we grow; it is an encouragement to each of us to dare to trust ourselves, to dig deep, to open up every latent capability, to break our own limits, to become the most versatile and the finest version of who we are. Because in the age of AI, breadth of capability and the ability to harness the moment are the preconditions for lasting.
No one can know how many mysterious “strata” still lie hidden beneath the ground of modern technology and its markets. We know only this: once “Root Further” has become the spirit at our roots, we will meet any uncharted stretch of the road ahead not with fear but with appetite. Because we believe that within those very expanses lie countless wonders — and the chance to rise.

kudos.heading: Sun* Kudos
kudos.body: Recognising and thanking colleagues — held for the first time, and open to every Sunner. Running from November 2025, it invites Sun* people to share words of recognition and thanks for their colleagues on the system announced by the organising committee. This will be material the Heads Council draws on when selecting the award recipients.
